name: Pull-Up
variations: Pronated grip (palms away); Shoulder-width, wide or narrow grip; Mixed grip
injury_cautions: Stop if the shoulders or elbows pinch

name: Chin-Up
variations: Supinated grip; Narrow or shoulder-width grip; Pause at the top

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
variations: Narrow or wide neutral handles; Pause at the top; Slow lowering (3 s)
injury_cautions: Keep the shoulders down, no shrugging

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
variations: Slightly wide vs very wide grip; Pause at the top; Slow lowering (3 s)

name: Negative Pull-Up
variations: 3 s, 5 s or 8 s lowering; Pronated or supinated grip; Pause halfway down

name: Scapular Pull-Up
variations: Pronated or neutral grip; Pause at the top (2 s); Active hang for time
injury_cautions: Keep the movement small and slow

name: Parallel-Bar Dip
variations: Upright torso (triceps) vs forward lean (chest); Narrow or wide handles; Pause at the bottom
injury_cautions: Stop if the shoulders feel pinched

name: Pistol Squat
variations: Box or bench to sit to; Counterweight held in front (goblet); Slow lowering (3 s)
injury_cautions: Progress from the assisted version first

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
variations: Bodyweight, dumbbell or barbell; Foot closer or further from the hips; Pause at the top (2 s)
injury_cautions: Keep the ribs down, no back arch

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
variations: Low, medium or high box; Goblet hold instead of sides; Slow lowering (3 s)
injury_cautions: Do not push off the back foot

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
variations: Short vs long stride; Alternating or one side at a time; Goblet or dumbbells at the sides

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
variations: Torso upright (quads) vs forward lean (glutes); Goblet hold; Rear foot higher or lower
injury_cautions: Keep the front heel down and torso steady
